staticTargetPrecision.rule: Exact constant-reference runs, at least 5 matched samples and 100 ms, no gap over 75 ms. Includes settling and drift; define a fixation-only protocol for controlled precision.

interpretation: Offline error against supplied reference labels. This does not establish real-world webcam accuracy; hold out participants and calibration targets.
protocol: Deterministic scorer conformance test: constant 10px bias, zero jitter; not human or webcam-model measurements.
